programs.title: Battle After Another
programs.desc: Pat (Leonardo DiCaprio) hides under a changed name as Bob Ferguson with his daughter Willa in a town in the desert.No one knows that in the past, this inconspicuous man was the leader of a group of revolutionaries that committed numerous acts of sabotage: his accomplices freed refugees, robbed banks and blew up government buildings.Sixteen years after the attack on the prison, the leader of the elusive gang is tracked down by his old enemy, Colonel Steven Lockjaw (Sean Penn), who was obsessed with Bob's beloved, Willy's mother.When the girl is kidnapped, her desperate father asks her former mentor (Benicio Del Toro) for help.Together they set off to search for the hostage.

programs.title: Half Man
programs.desc: 1980s. The life of bullied teenage Niall (Mitchell Robertson) turns upside down when the son of his mother's partner, the fierce and unpredictable Ruben (Stuart Campbell), comes to live with them for a while.Even though they are not related by blood, over time they both become inseparable.However, subsequent events make them move away from each other.Three decades later, Ruben (Richard Gadd) shows up uninvited at Niall's (Jamie Bell) wedding.It soon becomes clear why he reconnected with his long-lost brother.A suggestive story about the fragility of male relationships, brotherhood, betrayal, loyalty and violence.

programs.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
programs.desc: Southport, a fishing community in North Carolina.Four friends - Helen, her boyfriend Barry, Julie and Ray - are driving home from celebrating the Fourth of July.Suddenly, a figure in a fisherman's cape appears on the road.Barry, who is under the influence of alcohol, hits the brake too late.The young people decide not to notify the police about the accident and throw the body into the water.Their plans are not changed even by the fact that the victim shows faint signs of life.After returning home, they cannot recover.Julie becomes depressed.A year after the tragic events, the girl receives a blood-curdling anonymous letter.It reads: "I know what you did last summer."Soon the nightmare begins.A box office hit of horror cinema, which turned out to be a career ticket for the actors playing the main roles.A slasher based on the 1973 novel, written by Kevin Williamson, who proved his ability to scare by writing the script for "Scream".

programs.title: Georgie \u0026 Mandy'S First Marriage 2
programs.desc: Young married couple Georgie and Mandy are raising their daughter, learning everyday life in their new role as parents.Each day brings new challenges and fatigue that puts their relationship to the test.

programs.title: Manodrome
programs.desc: Ralphie (Jesse Eisenberg) recently lost his job.He barely makes ends meet by moonlighting as an Uber driver, while his partner Sal (Odessa Young) is about to give birth.Ralphie is not prepared for his new role, and his problems make it difficult for him to control his emotions.Seeing his helplessness and growing frustration, his gym friend Jason introduces him to the charismatic Dan (Adrien Brody), the leader of a mysterious group of celibate men who preach patriarchy.Ralphie, in crisis, is drawn into their world.Over time, he develops a dangerous obsession.
